name: DynaMath
intro: DynaMath是一个动态视觉数学基准，用于评估视觉语言模型在受控题目变体下的数学推理鲁棒性。它包含501个Python种子程序；论文评测为每个种子采样10个变体，共5,010道具体问题。题型包括296道数值题、174道选择题和31道自由作答题。
org: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, UC Berkeley
build_method: 视觉数学题筛选, STEM学生策略标注, Python程序化生成, 人工程序质检
metric: Average-case Accuracy (Aavg), Worst-case Accuracy (Awst), Reasoning Robustness (RR), Repetition Consistency (RC)
task_type: 选择题、数值题与自由作答视觉数学问答
eval_feature: 动态视觉与文本变体, 平均与最坏性能对照, 重复一致性
scale: 501个种子程序, 每题10个评测变体, 共5,010个具体问题
task_type_en: Multiple-choice, numerical, and free-form visual math QA
build_method_en: Visual-math seed curation, STEM-student strategy annotation, Python program generation, manual program QA
eval_feature_en: Dynamic visual and textual variants, average-versus-worst performance, repetition consistency
intro_en: DynaMath is a dynamic visual-math benchmark for measuring VLM mathematical-reasoning robustness under controlled problem variants. It contains 501 Python seed programs; the paper samples 10 variants per seed for 5,010 concrete questions. The seed types are 296 numerical, 174 multiple-choice, and 31 free-form questions.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with DynaMath arXiv:2411.00836v2 and the official repository fixed at 598c3c3. Its 501 seeds span elementary 63, high school 277, and undergraduate 161 levels. The main robustness grid is 501 × 10 = 5,010 generated questions, while RC is an independent 501 × 5 response track. The flow preserves the seven variation families, 470 plotting and 31 fixed-image programs, Aavg, Awst, and RR = Awst/Aavg. Appendix H.6 is labeled only as an in-context learning contamination proxy, not formal decontamination. The paper reports comprehensive review and carefully crafted programs but does not disclose a specific program-QA checklist, so none is invented.
